verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents permission schemes, roles, or view/edit access controls for Jira. "SAML & SSO" is an authentication feature, and "Global and project-level configuration" describes configuration scope rather than granular permissions, so both are only adjacent and earn no credit. The axis clearly applies to a work-tracking tool, so the lack of evidence yields "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As a product manager, I can assign granular permissions and roles to control who can view or edit work
